text: A reader who attends to what is wanting in this passage will be repaid more than by anything it sets down. Sarah has no place in the chapter at all, and the next verse reports her death. The narrator nowhere says that something in the household perished upon the mountain; yet the scene leaves that impression, and his silence conveys it as plainly as a statement would have done. He withdraws at the very point where a meaner story would have lingered. Abraham returns to the servants, and of Isaac nothing is said.
